## ExecSpec Objects

```python
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExecSpec()
```

Run argv without an implicit shell; None inherits the parent environment. A sandbox derives PWD from resolved cwd, and an explicit PWD must agree with that directory.

<a id="aibuildai_exec.Executor"></a>

## Executor Objects

```python
class Executor()
```

Bind one application-owned delegated root; never re-execute the application.

The host must provide an exclusive delegated cgroup. An explicit external_root provides no local kernel limits; descendant cleanup is best effort.

<a id="aibuildai_exec.Executor.scope"></a>

#### scope

```python
def scope(*,
          name: str,
          memory_bytes: int | None = None,
          cpu_cores: float | None = None,
          pids: int | None = None,
          gpu_devices: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
          read_paths: Collection[str | Path] | None = None,
          write_paths: Collection[str | Path] | None = None,
          optional_read_paths: Collection[str | Path] | None = None,
          mask_paths: Collection[str | Path] = (),
          sandbox: bool | None = None,
          attach_host: bool = False,
          control_pids: int | None = None,
          launcher_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> Scope
```

Declare a Scope in this tree; enter it before starting work.

<a id="aibuildai_exec.Executor.close"></a>

#### close

```python
async def close() -> None
```

Reject new work, finish owned cleanup, and release the live handle.

class Process()

## Scope Objects

```python
class Scope()
```

A live node handle in its Executor's tree; it stores no child topology.

<a id="aibuildai_exec.Scope.scope"></a>

#### scope

```python
def scope(*,
          name: str,
          memory_bytes: int | None = None,
          cpu_cores: float | None = None,
          pids: int | None = None,
          gpu_devices: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
          read_paths: Collection[str | Path] | None = None,
          write_paths: Collection[str | Path] | None = None,
          optional_read_paths: Collection[str | Path] | None = None,
          mask_paths: Collection[str | Path] = (),
          sandbox: bool | None = None,
          launcher_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> Scope
```

Declare a Scope in this tree; enter it before starting work.

<a id="aibuildai_exec.Scope.start"></a>

#### start

```python
async def start(spec: ExecSpec) -> Process
```

Start one process in a distinct leaf under this Scope.

<a id="aibuildai_exec.Scope.run"></a>

#### run

```python
async def run(spec: ExecSpec) -> ExecOutcome
```

Use start and wait; descendant cleanup is best effort without a cgroup.

<a id="aibuildai_exec.Scope.close"></a>

#### close

```python
async def close() -> None
```

Reject new work and serialize cleanup with the same tree's other scopes.

```python
async def terminate_command(tool_use_id: str) -> None
```

Stop a command; descendant cleanup is best effort without a cgroup.
